title: AquaTerra in March 2025: {count} drives across Kolkata
description: March 2025 at AquaTerra: {count} drives across {placesCount} places, from the Sharbat Seva summer run and Food For All to dog feeding and workshops.
lede: In March 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Most were summer relief drives: sharbat handed out to passersby and devotees, and bananas and packed meals from Food For All. The rest were dog feeding drives, toy and clothes collections and children's workshops, with {topPlace} the most frequent place.

sections.heading: a sharbat run and a food run, side by side
body: The [Sharbat Seva](/impact/sharbat-seva) drives made up the biggest part of the month, running from 26 to 29 March at places across the city. They included Topsia, the Shiv Temple in Salt Lake, Sarat Bose Road, Howrah, Beleghata, Babylon Lounge, New Alipore and Lake Town Footbridge. The drives each handed out 20 litres of Rooh Afza sharbat to people in the heat.

Food For All ran alongside them, from Shiv Temple in Salt Lake on 26 March to Hazra on 30 March. Its first drive there noted 600 bananas distributed, and the New Alipore and Howrah drives on 28 March describe packed meals handed out so that no one walked away hungry. The series is one of the simplest ways AquaTerra covers ground quickly with a small team.

sections.heading: dogs, toys and clothes
body: [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) ran feeding drives in March. Drive 28.0 and Drive 29.0 were on 21 March, at Salt Lake Haveli and Shibpur, and Drive 30.0 and 31.0 were on 22 March, at Salt Lake and Bangur. The Shibpur drive and the Bangur drive each note 90 dogs fed, and they had the largest teams of the month.

Toy and Thread collected clothes and toys at Hemchandra Naskar Road on 26 March, where the drive notes 7 bags collected, and at New Alipore and Ballygunge Park on 28 March. Cycle of Care at Salt Lake Haveli on 21 March gave out sanitary napkins to women near a slum area to promote hygiene, and the drive lists 80 packets donated.

sections.heading: children's workshops through the month
body: Pather Sathi hosted a string of workshops: Math Minds on 8 March, Budget Basics on 14 March, Holi Hues on 15 March, Pebble Pop on 22 March, and Chill and Cheer and Speak Skillfully on 29 March. Holi Hues was a party with organic colours, and Pint Party on 1 March was a guided drawing session.

Elsewhere, School On Wheels hosted science, story and origami sessions: Tale Time on 5 March, Origami Time on 3 March and Think and Tinker on 24 March. Brush Battle, an art competition at AIM Foundation on 7 March, gave stationery sets to the top winners, and Money Talks at Tiljala Shed on 21 March taught saving and budgeting.

sections.heading: how to help with a month like this
body: Most relief drives had small teams at one place. If you want to help, [join AquaTerra](/join) and sign up for the next run, or read [how to run a sharbat stall](/impact/how-to-run-a-sharbat-stall) before you plan one.
Places that host several drives in one month, such as Pather Sathi in March, are the easiest ones to plan around.

learnings: A simple format repeated at many places in a few days, like sharbat, covers a lot of ground without a large team at any one stop.
Relief drives and children's workshops can run in the same week, so one month can hold both kinds of work.
A place that hosts several drives in one month is the easiest one to plan around.
